components.name: Selected Conversation Row
components.description: A recent private or group room in the sidebar; the active row is lightly tinted.
components.css: .ds-room { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid #dce6dc; border-radius: 9px; background: #eef3ec; color: #1f2d27; text-align: left; font: 12px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-room:hover { background: #f5f7f2; } .ds-room:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2e5c49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-room span:nth-child(2) { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-room small, .ds-room time { color: #65736b; font-size: 10px; } .ds-room time { align-self: flex-start; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #cbdacc; border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 4px; background: #e1eee3; color: #285d48; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 720; }

components.name: Stable Agent Identity Marks
components.description: Keeps Noema and a professional contact recognizable in room lists and headers.
components.css: .ds-identities { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 4px; font: 720 16px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-core { border-color: #cbdacc; background: #e1eee3; color: #285d48; } .ds-specialist { border-color: #e4d8c9; background: #f2e9dd; color: #815334; }

components.name: Conversation Bubbles
components.description: Separates user and agent turns by alignment and quiet surface color.
components.html:
我们可以在这里继续讨论。

components.css: .ds-thread { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font: 13px/1.72 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-bubble { max-width: 84%; margin: 0; padding: 12px 15px; border: 1px solid #e1e7e0; color: #1f2d27; } .ds-agent { align-self: flex-start; border-radius: 4px 13px 13px 13px; background: #f5f7f3; } .ds-user { align-self: flex-end; border-color: #2e5c49; border-radius: 13px 4px 13px 13px; background: #2e5c49; color: #fbfdf8; }

components.name: Per-turn Responder Choice
components.description: Shows who is selected to answer the next group-chat turn.
components.css: .ds-responder { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px 4px 5px; border: 1px solid #d5e0d5; border-radius: 7px; background: #edf3ed; color: #244536; font: 10px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-responder:hover { background: #f1f4ef; } .ds-responder:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2e5c49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mini-mark { display: grid; width: 20px; height: 20px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 3px; background: #e1eee3; color: #285d48; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 720; }

components.name: Message Composer
components.description: Room-bound multiline input with a compact send action and visible keyboard guidance.
components.html: Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-height: 106px; padding: 12px 14px 9px; border: 1px solid #cbd6cd; border-radius: 11px; background: #fff; transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #91ae98; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(46 92 73 / 8%); } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 0 6px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #1f2d27; font: 13px/1.65 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; resize: none; } .ds-composer div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-composer small { color: #56645b; font: 10px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-composer button { min-width: 72px; height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #2e5c49; border-radius: 7px; background: #2e5c49; color: #fff; font: 650 10px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer button:hover { background: #244536; } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2e5c49; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Group Member Selection
components.description: Selected contacts are shown as a lightly tinted row when creating a separate group room.
components.css: .ds-member { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 9px; border: 1px solid #cbdaca; border-radius: 8px; background: #f1f5ef; color: #1f2d27; font: 11px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-member:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #2e5c49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-member input { accent-color: #2e5c49; } .ds-member .ds-mini-mark { display: grid; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 20px; height: 20px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 3px; background: #e1eee3; color: #285d48; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 720; }

components.name: Create a Professional Contact
components.description: Creates a user-owned specialist identity from a long-term practice area and collaboration approach without asking for system-prompt editing or implying connected tools.
components.css: .agent-create-dialog { width: min(100%, 470px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 32px); overflow: auto; padding: 23px; border: 1px solid #d7dfd7; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--chat-paper); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgb(21 35 26 / 18%); } .agent-create-dialog textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 84px; resize: vertical; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--chat-line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--chat-paper); color: var(--chat-ink); font: 12px/1.55 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Local Model Service Status
components.description: Reports the local FreeLLMAPI connection state alongside the selected model context.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 11px; border: 1px solid #dce3dc; border-radius: 8px; background: #f6f8f4; color: #4e6154; font: 11px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
This Windows-first, Chinese-first desktop slice uses familiar chat conventions. The active room owns the main area; a recent-chat sidebar keeps Noema and professional agents easy to return to. Stable agent identities appear across rooms, while each private or group room keeps its own transcript. In group rooms, the sender can choose who responds to each turn. A capable specialist can also receive an explicit project-work handoff; its activity and separately verified file result return to the same room. This is the current assistant-selected interface direction, not a user-confirmed brand identity.

The interface uses a quiet warm-gray-green ground around paper-white chat surfaces, forest-green actions, and distinct identity marks for Noema and a professional contact. The roomy desktop layout gives the conversation most of the space. On narrow screens, the app switches between the chat list and the selected room, retaining a compact top bar and direct navigation back. Model and service information stays visible but secondary to the room and its messages.

The palette, type scale, and surface styling document this implementation slice. They remain changeable design choices, not permanent Noema brand assets. The earlier root-conversation and background-worker composition is historical; it is not the current main chat surface.

The stylesheet also retains earlier `#legacy` interface rules before the `.social-shell` block. Those styles are deprecated for the current main surface and are outside this design system; do not reuse their one-off values as current social-chat tokens.
keyCharacteristics: A room-centered chat surface with a persistent desktop contact/recent-chat list.
Stable identity marks distinguish Noema from professional agents across separate rooms.
Group turns expose an explicit responder choice.
Project work is started explicitly and returns as a verifiable activity within its originating room.
Local transcript storage and the selected FreeLLMAPI model boundary are stated in the interface.

rules.name: The Room Truth Rule
rules.body: Use color to identify people, places, and current state. Never use a status color to imply a reply succeeded, a model is reachable now, or an agent has capabilities that the live state does not confirm.

dos: Do make the current room the main focus and keep the sidebar about returning to a person or recent conversation.
Do preserve separate private and group transcripts while reusing stable agent identity marks.
Do show the group responder choice for each turn and identify which agent actually replied.
Do keep project work attached to its room and distinguish worker output from Noema's independent file verification.
Do keep model and service state present but subordinate, with wording tied to the state the app actually knows.
Do retain the local-storage and FreeLLMAPI data boundary in concise, readable language.
Do let narrow screens move cleanly between the chat list and one active room.
Do treat the current palette and type as implementation choices that may evolve.
donts: Don't turn the main chat into a dashboard, task panel, or abstract relationship map.
Don't imply cross-room memory, personality growth, tool execution, or external-provider state unless the implementation establishes it.
Don't equate a model directory's “ready” label or service connection with a successful response.
Don't describe Noema or professional agents as conscious or as having human feelings.
Don't present the green and beige palette as a user-approved permanent brand system.
